Tyraminoporpine is known to interact with potassium voltage-gated channels, suggesting a possible mechanism by which 4'-O-Methylscutellarein might influence these channels through its interaction with the Muscarinic receptor. The score of 0.6013 indicates a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, supported by the sequential targeting of the receptor and channel.
